title: Expert planning proposal
description: Returned by each book-guided expert to the coordinator in architecture-planning.

book_practices.description: One entry for every selected book, tracing its practices to constraints and proposed architecture output.

book_id.description: Exact id from this expert's selected book list.

title.description: Exact title from the selected book list.

edition.description: Exact edition from the selected book list.

knowledge_basis.description: The expert used its pretrained knowledge; this is not a claim about exact training-set membership.

chapters_used.description: Distinct chapters recalled and used. Every chapter must contribute at least one applied practice.

chapter.description: Exact chapter number and title recalled for this edition.

sections.description: Exact section names recalled and used from this chapter.

practice.description: A named principle or practice specifically associated with this chapter or its listed sections.

interpretation.description: What the practice means in the expert's own words.

architecture_evidence.description: The concrete constraint, design, code, or artifact examined through this practice.

applied_to.description: The exact option, decision, or recommendation shaped by this practice.

application.description: How applying the practice to the evidence shaped the proposed architecture.

summary.description: Components, interfaces, data, and key flows in a few sentences.

change_cost.description: What it costs to evolve or reverse this option later.

smallest_viable_form.description: The smallest version of this option that meets known needs.

reason.description: Why it wins against the stated constraints.

standards_conformance.description: Required from the AI architect (role ai). One entry per artifact and standard pair for agent skills, plugins, MCP servers or clients, and agent instruction files in scope; a single not_applicable entry when the scope has none.

artifact.description: The skill, plugin, MCP server or client, or instruction file checked, by path or name.

clause.description: The section or rule of the standard that was checked.

evidence.description: What in the artifact shows the verdict; for not_applicable, why no such artifact is in scope.

assumptions.description: Missing facts or open decisions that could change the recommendation.
